summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results and corporate update. The filing discloses quarterly revenue of $3.1 million, reaffirms full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $24–26 million, and highlights progress in its EscharEx Phase III VALUE trial and a Master Services Agreement with Vericel under BARDA. These are routine operational and financial updates, not a special situation transaction. No merger, tender offer, activist, spin-off, restructuring, or other categorized event is present. The filing is a standard periodic report under the 1934 Act for a foreign private issuer.
